dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The most prominent O-shaped structures exhibit irregular, undulating perimeters with a sharp tonal transition from dark brown exterior pixels to a thin, high-intensity light-tan band enclosing a dark brown interior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of asymmetrical light-tan pixel clusters concentrated along the dorsal-lateral midline, consisting of solid pixel groupings and thin curvilinear segments lacking internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A primary obtuse triangle is formed by the centroids of the three largest annuli in the mid-dorsal region, with a secondary linear alignment of four smaller high-intensity blobs extending toward the posterior flank.
